system.description:
Mysterious mental abilities give you the ability to manifest a variety of powers with but a thought.

Powers/Qualities

Assign at least two dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to powers from the Psychic category. If you already have one or more Psychic powers, assign dice to ensure that you have at least two Psychic powers.

Assign any remaining dice to the following categories:

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Materials powers category

• Select from Psychic powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

• Select from Information qualities category

• Select from Mental qualities category

Abilities

Gain two of the following Green abilities.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.7ci4p14uFfTwn0BY]{Psychic Assault}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.XjB4NXJlXqODH0zr]{Psychic Coordination}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.49JGzmia1g39hN1J]{Psychic Insight}

Gain two of the following Yellow abilities that you have the associated power or quality for.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.6E6gotEupTh8vP0q]{Astral Projection}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.0LCGlBFO4kKd0HwW]{Illusionary Double}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.5xf8IJsVbnXDh30t]{Minion Suggestion}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.H8Okwp3sMCgDkyB5]{Postcognitive Understanding}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.UEiOm3n2OCxfKZ8W]{Precognitive Alteration}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.Rbgrq1pI0HgHCJR9]{Psychic Analysis}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.UB3DqVhCs3eURuIS]{Swarm}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.TAJpPFFt7czGReZT]{Telekinetic Assault}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.rRG1IaVBuXOEe7V6]{Telepathic Whammy}
Principle

Choose an Esoteric principle.

Personality

Roll d10, d10 for personality selection.
